en: There is none so unfortunate as I, throughout this earth, mobile or immobile, and it is for this bad luck that I have confronted this mighty disaster.

sa: तिष्ठन् सम्प्रेक्ष्य च तदा पत्नी रामस्य रावणः॥ शुभां रुचिरदन्तोष्ठी पूर्णचन्दनिभाननाम्। आसीनां पर्णशालायां बाष्पशोकाभिपीडिताम्॥
en: Her lips and teeth were extremely fine, her face resembled the full moon and her eyes were like lotus-petals. She had a yellow siiken cloth on and sat in the thatched cottage, overwhelmed with grief and bathed in tears.

sa: आसाद्य तं द्विजश्रेष्ठं रोमपादसमीपगम्॥ ऋषिपुत्रं ददर्शाथो दीप्यमानमिवानलम्।
en: And coming before that best of regenerate ones, he saw that sage's son near Romapāda, like that of a flaming fire.

sa: पिबन्निव बभौ चापि सोर्मिजालं महार्णवम्। पिपासुरिव चाकाशं ददृशे स महाकपिः॥
en: He appeared as if he was drinking up the mightily deep with its multitudes of waves, or as if that redoubtable monkey was desirous of sucking up the sky itself.

sa: आर्तनादो हि यः पौरैरुन्मुक्तस्त्वत्प्रवासने। सरथं मां निशाम्यैव कुर्युः शतगुणं ततः॥
en: They will on seeing me with the car, burst out into lamentations exceeding a hundred times in bitterness those in which they indulged when you set out for the forest.

sa: सागरस्योर्मिजालानामुरसा शैलवर्मणाम्। अभिघ्नंस्तु महावेगः पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः॥
en: That mighty monkey possessed of exceeding speed rushed on, raising multitudes of surges on the sea by his breast resembling rock.

sa: गतासु तासु सर्वासु काश्यपस्यात्मजो द्विजः। अस्वस्थहृदयश्चासीद् दुःखाच्च परिवर्तते॥
en: And when they had gone, that twice-born one, Kasyapa's son, became sad, and suffered from grief of heart and became restless due to sadness.

sa: बह्नीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणामाहृतानामितस्ततः। सर्वासामेव भद्रं ते महाग्रमहिषी भव॥
en: I have brought many a beautiful damsel from various quarters, do you become my foremost Queen among them.

sa: पुरुषव्याघ्रः कैकेय्याः : प्रतिगृह्य ते। सूक्ष्मवस्त्रमवक्षिप्य मुनिवस्त्राण्यवस्त ह॥
en: On this, that foremost of men taking those two pieces of bark from Kaikeyi, left his fine attire and put on the ascetic garb.

sa: सत्त्वाभिजनसम्पन्नः सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः। कृतज्ञः सत्यवादी च राजा लोके महीयते॥
en: The king that is nobly endowed by heredily, and is kind, that has subdued his senses, and is grateful and truth telling, obtains renown in this world.

sa: मम संजातरोषस्य मुखं दृष्ट्वैव मैथिलि। विद्रवन्ति परित्रस्ताः सुराः शक्रपुरोगमाः॥
en: O Maithilee, when I am excited with ire, Indra and other celestials at the mere sight of my countenance fly away in divers directions out of fear.

sa: तासां तेनातिकान्तेन वचनेन सुवर्चसाम्। मुखपद्मान्यशोभन्त पद्मानीव हिमात्यये॥
en: And hearing those sweet words, the countenances of those shining dames looked resplendent, like lotuses after the cold season is over.

sa: स कामिनं दीनमदीनसत्त्वं शोकाभिपत्रं समुदीर्णकोपम्। नरेन्द्रसूनुर्नरदेवपुत्रं रामानुजः पूर्वजमित्युवाच॥
en: Lakşmaņa again addressed his high-minded elder brother, the son of a king, influenced by passion, stricken with grief, and poorly, with the following words.

sa: कथं वैश्रवणं देवं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्। भ्रातरं व्यपदिश्य त्वमशुभं कर्तुमिच्छसि॥
en: How do you wish to perpetrate such an impious deed after introducing as your brother that highly worshipful Kubera adored by all the deities.

sa: अर्क तुद्यां शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विभिन्द्यां हि महीतलम्। कामरूपेण उन्मत्ते पश्य मां कामरूपिणम्॥
en: With my sharpened shafts I can pierce the Sun and cut asunder the earth. You are mad with your beauty. Do you look upon me, who am capable of illusions.

sa: अस्य वाहनसंयुक्तां कर्णग्राहवती शुभाम्। सुप्रतारां दृढां तीर्थे शीघ्रं नावमुपाहर ॥
en: Do you without delay bring to this bathingplace a strong and elegant boat furnished with a rudder and steered by a helmsman, such as is capable of ferrying (people) comfortably.

sa: इति कृत्वा मतिं साध्वी समुद्रश्छन्नमम्भसि। हिरण्यनाभं मैनाकमुवाच गिरिसत्तमम्॥
en: Having arrived at this wholesome resolution, the Ocean spake upto that best of mountains, Maināka, hued in gold and situate in the waters, saying.

sa: तस्य चैवंप्रभावस्य धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मनः। सुतार्थं तप्यमानस्य नासीद् वंशकरः सुतः॥
en: And although engaged in austerities with the view of having sons born to him, the powerful and high-souled king, had no son capable of perpetuating his race.

sa: वधूनाटकसंधैश्च संयुक्तां सर्वतः पुरीम्। उद्यानाम्रवणोपेतां महतीं सालमेखलाम्॥
en: And the mighty city contained theatres for females, and gardens, and mango-groves; and was enclosed by a wall of såla trees.

sa: एकस्य नापराधेन लोकान् हन्तुं त्वमर्हसि। ननु जानामि कस्यायं भग्नः सांग्रामिको रथः॥
en: It become you not to devastate the whole world for the crime of an individual being. Methinks for certain, this shattered car must be the property of an individual person, not of many.

sa: पुरा भूत्वा मृदुर्दान्तः सर्वभूतहिते रतः। न क्रोधवशमापन्नः प्रकृति हातुमर्हसि ॥
en: Ere this you had been gently, self-controlled and engaged in the welfare of all beings. It dose not behove you now to renounce your natural temper being influenced by ire.

sa: अथ क्रोधाद् दशग्रीवो जग्राह दश मार्गणान्। मृत्युदण्डनिभान् घोराशत्रोनिधनकासया॥ स तैर्बाणैर्महावीर्यः पूर्णमुक्तैरजिह्मगैः। बिभेद निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैधं घोरैः शिलीमुखैः॥
en: Thereupon, to destroy his enemy, that mighty hero, the Ten-necked Ravana, being exercised with ire, took up ten terrible arrows like to the sceptre of Death, and stretching the bow to the full he shot those straight-coursing sharpened shafts at Jatayu, the king of birds.

sa: समुत्थितमसङ्गेन हनूमानग्रतः स्थितम्। मध्ये लवणतोयस्य विघ्नोऽयमिति निश्चितः॥
en: Beholding before him that up-heaved mountain in the midst of the salt Ocean Hanumān regarded it, as a barrier for aye.

sa: संछिन्नबाहोः सद्यो वै बाहवः सहसाभवन्। विषज्वालावलीयुक्ता वल्मीकादिव पन्नगाः॥
en: His arms cut off, instantly sprang up as many others, like to serpents issuing out of ant-hills, being exercised with the pangs of poison.

sa: निवृत्तवनवासस्त्वामनृणो जगतीपतेः। पुनर्द्रक्ष्यामि मात्रा च पित्रा च सह संगतः॥
en: Returning from my abode in the woods, I will, freed from my debt to the lord of earth, behold you again along with my father and mother.

sa: कृते च प्रतिकर्तव्यमेष धर्मः सनातनः॥ सोऽयं तत्प्रतिकारार्थी त्वत्तः सम्मानमर्हति।
en: The best and everlasting virtue consists in returning benefits to one who has benefited us. Bent on returning benefits to Raghu's race, he deserve respect from you.

sa: श्रुत्वा वस्तु समग्रं तद्धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। व्यक्तमन्वेषते भूयो यद् वृत्तं तस्य धीमतः॥
en: Having heard the entire prevalent history of the intelligent Rāma, capable of conferring religious merit and the two other cognate objects, as well as emancipation, Vālmīki again sought to get insight into it.

sa: तप्ताभरणवर्णाङ्गी पीतकौशेयवासिनी। रराज राजपुत्री तु विद्युत्सौदामनी यथा॥
en: And then the king's daughter hued like molten gold, clad in a yellow silken cloth, looked exceedingly beautiful like to lighting.

sa: गोमती चाप्यतिक्रम्य राघवः शीघ्रगैर्हयैः। मयूरहंसाभिरुतां ततार स्यन्दिकां नदीम्॥
en: Having passed the Gomatī, Rāghava by means of fleet-coursing horses next crossed over the river Sandika resounding with the cries of cranes and peacocks.

sa: गत्वा तु सुचिरं कालं ततः शीतवहां नदीम्। गोमती गोयुतानूपामतरत् सागरङ्गमाम्॥
en: Then proceeding for a good while, he crossed the cool flowing stream Gomati running in the direction of the ocean, with its banks filled with kine and inundating its edge.

sa: तौ लोहितस्य प्रियदर्शनस्य सदोचितावुत्तमचन्दनस्य। वृत्तौ स्तनौ शोणितपङ्कदिग्धौ नूनं प्रियाया मम नाभिपातः॥
en: For certain my dear wife's breast round and sprinkled as it was with red sandal paste, was bathed in blood (while devoured by the Rākş asas) but there is no death for me.

sa: ग्रामान् विकृष्टसीमान्तान् पुष्पितानि वनानि च। पश्यन्नतिययौ शीघ्रं शनैरिव हयोत्तमैः॥
en: And seeing villages having ploughed fields on their skirts, and powering woods, he by means of those excellent horses, proceeded very fast although seeming to go slowly.

sa: अकर्दममिदं तीर्थे भरद्वाज निशामय। रमणीयं प्रसन्नाम्बु सन्मनुष्यमनो यथा।५।।
en: Saying-O Bharadvāja, behold this holy spot devoid of mud. And it is beautiful, and contains pleasant waters, even like the minds of good men.

sa: रोषरोदनताम्राक्षी भीमाक्षं राक्षसाधिपम्। रुदती करुणं सीता ह्रियमाणा तमब्रवीत्॥
en: Her eyes expressing rage, weeping and fright, Sītā, as she was being carried away, weeping piteously, spoke to the grim-eyed lord of the Raksasas.

sa: यथा वै मृगसंघाश्च गोमायुश्चैव भैरवम्। वाशन्ते शकुनाश्चापि प्रदीप्तामभितो दिशम्। अपि स्वस्ति भवेत् तस्या राजपुत्र्या महाबल॥
en: As these multitudes of beasts and these jackals are crying frightfully in the flaming direction*, I do not know, O you of mighty strength, whether it is well with that daughter of the king. i.e. The quarter presided over by the sun, vic., the East.

sa: दर्शयामास चात्मानं समुद्रः सरितां पतिः। समुद्रवचनाच्चैव नलं सेतुमकारयत्॥
en: Then that lord of rivers, the Ocean, showed himself. And agreeably to the advice of the Ocean, Nala constructed a bridge (over the water.)

sa: नहि धर्मार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं पानमेवं प्रशस्यते। पानादर्थश्च कामश्च धर्मश्च परिहीयते॥
en: For the attainment of piety and wealth, drinking is not a proper course. It is by drinking that people lose piety, wealth and desire.

sa: तदा यथागतेनैव मार्गेण क्लान्तचेतसः। अयोध्यामगमन् सर्वे पुरीं व्यथितसज्जनाम्॥
en: Then they returned to the city of Ayodhyā with its good people oppressed with grief, by the self-same way by which they had come.

sa: सोऽङ्गदं रोषताम्राक्षः संदिदेश महायशाः। सुग्रीवः कथ्यतां वत्स ममागमनमित्युत॥ एष रामानुजः प्राप्तस्त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसंतप्तो द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः॥ तस्य वाक्यं यदि रुचिः क्रियतां साधु वानर। इत्युक्त्वा शीघ्रमागच्छ वत्स वाक्यमरिंदम॥
en: Thereupon the far-famed Laksmana, having his eyes reddened with ire, spoke to Argada, saying-0 child, do you inform Sugriva of my arrival. O conqueror of foes, do you tell him:-'Laksmana, the younger brother of Rama, being stricken with grief on account his brother's disaster, has come to you and is waiting at the gate. If it pleaseth you, do you make good your promise.' Saying these words do you speedily return, O my child, O conqueror of foes.

sa: ते महौघनिभं दृष्ट्वा वज्राशनिसमस्वनम्। सिंहनादं समं चक्रुर्लक्ष्मणस्य समीपतः॥
en: They, approaching Lakşmaņa began to set up a terrible roar like to thunder and resembling the uproar of lions and the noise of water-falls.

sa: तेन तत्रैव वसता जनस्थाननिवासिनी। विरूपिता शूर्पणखा राक्षसी कामरूपिणी॥
en: It was while he was living there that, that dweller of Janasthāna, the Rākṣasī Śūrpanakhā, capable of assuming any form at will, was disfigured.

sa: अभिवाद्य नमस्यन्तं शूरं ससुहृदं सुतम्। मुदाः प्रोक्षसे पुत्रं मेघराजिरिवाचलम्॥
en: And even as a Chain of clouds speaks to a hill, you will speak to your worshipful and heroic son, surrounded by his friends. bowing to you.

sa: शक्तस्त्रैलोक्यमप्येष भोक्तुं किन्नु महीमिमाम्। नास्य क्रोधः प्रसादश्च निरर्थोऽस्ति कदाचन॥
en: He is capable of bearing the burden even of the three worlds, what then is this Earth? Neither his pleasure nor his displeasure even goes for naught.

sa: गान्धर्वे च भुवि श्रेष्ठो बभूव भरताग्रजः। कल्याणाभिजनः साधुरदीनात्मा महामतिः॥
en: And Bharata's elder brother is a proficient in music. He is the home of the good, and is saintly, and has conquered his grief, and is magnanimous.

sa: दिव्यैर्गुणैः शक्रसमो रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। इक्ष्वाकुभ्योऽपि सर्वेभ्यो ह्यतिरिक्तो विशाम्पते॥
en: O monarch, furnished with the choicest qualities, Rāma having truth for prowess is like to Sakra's self; and he towers above Ikşvāku and all.

sa: क्वचिन्मणिनिकाशोदां क्वचित् पुलिनशालीनीम्। क्पाचेत् सिद्धजनाकीर्णां पश्य मन्दाकिनी नदीम्॥
en: And behold the river Mandakini, somewhere with its waters resembling pearls, and somewhere with islets, and somewhere filled with persons who have attained emancipation.

sa: न त केकयराजानं जनकं वा नराधिपः। त्वरया चानयामास पश्चात्तौ श्रोष्यतः प्रियम्॥
en: But that lord of men did not, on account of haste, bring over either Janaka or the king of the Kekayas, concluding that a little while after they would receive the glad tidings.

sa: तं देवदेवोपममात्मजं ते सर्वस्य लोकस्य हिते निविष्टम्। हिताय नः क्षिप्रमुदारजुष्टं मुदाभिषेक्तुं वरद त्वमर्हसि ॥
en: Therefore, O bestower of boons, it behoves you, for the sake of our well-being, with a delighted mind to speedily install your son furnished with noble qualities resembling the god of gods, and every intent upon the welfare of the entire community.

sa: अप्रधृष्यश्च संग्रामे क्रुद्धैरपि सुरासुरैः। अनसूयो जितक्रोधो न हप्तो न च मत्सरी॥
en: He was incapable of being repressed in fight even by the enraged gods and Asuras. He was not given to carping, and had subdued his anger, and he was never elated, or malicious.

sa: श्रैष्ठ्यं चास्त्रसमूहेषु प्राप्तो व्यामिश्रकेषु च। अर्थधर्मों च संगृह्य सुखतन्त्रो न चालसः॥
en: He had attained proficiency in all the scriptures and literary works composed in both Sanskrit and Prakrit. He sought pleasure without sacrificing either interest or morality; and he was never dilatory in duty.

sa: भीष्म उवाच गिरं तां मधुरां श्रुत्वा गौतमो विस्मितस्तदा। कौतूहलान्वितो राजन् राजधर्माणमैक्षत॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these sweet words Gautama was filled with wonder. Feeling at the same time a great curiosity, he looked at Rajadharman without being able to with draw his eyes from him.

sa: तोऽब्रवीद् गौतमस्तं दरिद्रोऽहं महामते। समुद्रगमनाकाङ्क्षी द्रव्यार्थमिति भारत॥
en: Gautama answered him, saying, I am, O great one, very poor. For acquiring riches I wish to go to the sea.

sa: मित्रद्रोही नृशंसश्च कृतघ्नश्च नराधमः। क्रव्यादैः कृमिभिश्चैव न भुज्यन्ते हि तादृशाः॥
en: That cruel and mean man who does injury to a friend and turns ungrateful, is not eaten even by the very cannibals nor by the worms that feed on carrion.

sa: दिव्यां मालामुरसानेकवर्णां समुद्वहन्तं गुल्फदेशावलम्बाम्। चन्द्रं यथा परिविष्टं ससंध्यं वर्षात्यये तद्वदपश्यमेनम्॥
en: He wore an excellent garland of various colours on his bosom, that hung down to his toes. Indeed, I saw him like the highly bright moon of an autumnal evening.

sa: प्रयायतां किमास्यते समुत्थितं महद् भयम्। अतिप्रमाथि दारुणं सुखस्य संविधीयताम्॥
en: Follow the path of Liberation. Why do you delay? A frightful terror, destructive of your happiness, is before you: Do you take prompt mcasures for acquiring Liberation.

sa: योग एष हि योगानां किमन्यद् योगलक्षणम्। एवं पश्यं प्रपश्यन्ति आत्मानमजरं परम्॥
en: This is what is called the Yoga of Yogins. What else is the mark of Yoga? By such practices do Yogins succeed in seeing the Supreme Soul that is above destruction and decay.

sa: नमोऽस्तु ते शाश्वत सर्वयोने ब्रह्माधिपं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति। तपश्च सत्त्वं च रजस्तमश्च त्वामेव सत्यं च वदन्ति सन्तः॥
en: I saluted Mahadeva, saying I bow to you, o you, who are the origin of all things. The Rishis declare that you are the master of the Vedas. The pious hold that you are Penance, you are Sattwa, you are Rajas, you are Tamas, and you are Truth.

sa: प्रीतिमात्रं पितुः पुत्रः सर्वं पुत्रस्य वै पिता। शरीरादीनि देयानि पिता त्वेकः प्रयच्छति॥
en: The son is only a source of joy to his father. The father is all in all to a son. The body and all else that the son has he has got from the father alone.

sa: पिता ह्यात्मानमाधत्ते जायायां जज्ञिवानिति। शीलचारित्रगोत्रस्य धारणार्थं कुलस्य च॥
en: The father puts his own self within the mother's womb and takes birth as the son, for continuing his practices, conduct, name and race.

sa: भवन्तोऽपि च हृषयन्ति शोचन्ति च यथा वयम्। इन्द्रियार्थाश्च भवतां समानाः सर्वजन्तुषु॥
en: Even men like yourself are seen to yield to joy and indulge in grief as persons like ourselves. Like other creatures the senses of persons like yourselves have their functions or objects. an

sa: चिरकारिक भद्रं ते भद्रं ते चिरकारिक। चिरकारी हि मेधावी नापराध्यति कर्मसु॥
en: Twice blessed be the man who thinks long before he acts! One man who thinks long before he acts is surely possessed of great intelligence. Such a man never offends in an act.

sa: सत्याय हि यथा नेह जह्याद् धर्मफलं महत्। भूतानामनुकम्पार्थं मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Indeed, Manu, the son of the Self create, has, through pity for human beings, indicated the way by means of which men may follow knowledge for the sake of Liberation."

sa: एतानि सह यज्ञेन प्रजापतिकल्पयत्। तेन प्रजापतिर्देवान् यज्ञेनायजत प्रभुः॥
en: The Lord of the universe created them along with Sacrifice. The powerful Lord of all creatures made the god celebrate sacrifices with their help.

sa: श्रद्धा वैवस्वती सेयं सूर्यस्य दुहिता द्विज। सावित्री प्रसवित्री च बहिर्वाङ्मनसी ततः॥
en: Faith in Brahma is the daughter of the SunGod, O twice-bom one. She is the protectress and the giver of good birth. Faith is superior to the merit begotten by recitations and meditation.

sa: स्वयं यूपानुपादाय यजन्ते स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः। यस्तथा भावितात्मा स्यात् स गामालब्धुमर्हति॥
en: Creating sacrificial stakes by their willforce, they celebrate many kinds of Sacrifice with profuse presents. One who is of such a purified soul may kill a cow.

sa: स ईशो भगवान् देवः सर्वभूतात्मभावनः॥ अहो नारायणं तेजो दुर्दर्श द्विजसत्तम।
en: Narayana is the Supreme Lord. Illustrious and gifted with great power. He is the soul of all creatures. Indeed, O foremost of twice-born ones, the energy of Narayana is irresistible.

sa: मोक्षश्चोक्तस्त्वया ब्रह्मन् निर्वाणं परमं सुखम्। ये तु मुक्ता भवन्तीह पुण्यपापविवर्जिताः॥ ते सहस्रर्चिषं देवं प्रविशन्तीह शुश्रुम्।
en: Liberation has, O twice-born one, been described by you to be the highest happiness and to consist of the cessation of existence. They who being shorn of both merit and demerit, become liberated, succeed, we hear, in entering the great God of a thousand rays.

sa: न त्वेव वचनं किंचिदनिमित्तादिहोच्यते। सुविनीतेन शास्त्रेण न व्यवस्यन्त्यथापरे॥
en: Some hold that no scriptural text has been written without a reason, Others again, even if they properly understand the scriptures, never follow them.

sa: अमर्षाच्छास्त्रसम्मोहादविज्ञानाच्च भारत। शास्त्रं प्राज्ञस्य वदतः समूहे यात्यदर्शनम्॥
en: If even a wise man speaks of morality when he is angry or bewildered or ignorant, his speech produces no effect.

sa: यस्मादुद्विजते लोकः सर्वो मृत्युमुखादिव। वाक्क्राद् दण्डपरुषात् स प्राप्नोति महद् भयम्॥
en: On the other hand, that person who for his harsh words and bad temper, is troublesome to all creatures like death itself, certainly attains to a state full of fear.

sa: जितं भगवता तेन पुरुषेणेति भारत॥ नित्यं जप्यपरा भूत्वा सरस्वतीमुदीरयन्।
en: And all of them, O Bharata, silently meditating upon Narayana (from that day), uttered these words for His glorification, viz., Victory to that holy and illustrious Being.

sa: यश्चेदं पठते नित्यं यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नरः॥ एकान्तभावोपगत एकान्तेषु समाहितः। प्राप्य श्वेतं महाद्वीपं भूत्वा चन्द्रप्रभो नरः॥ स सहस्रार्चिषं देवं प्रविशेन्नात्र संशयः।
en: He who frequently reads this narrative, and he who frequently listens to it with rapt attention, in a secluded spot, and filled with devotion, succeeds, being possessed of lunar complexion, in living in the spacious insular continent known by the name of White Island. Forsooth, such a man succeeds in entering into Narayana of a thousand rays.

sa: क्षान्तमेव मयेत्युक्त्वा कुण्डधारो द्विजर्षभम्। सम्परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Then Kundadhara said That foremost of twice-born ones,-I have forgiven you!-and having embraced him with his arms disappeared there and then.

sa: स नद्यां समुपस्पृश्य तर्पयित्वा हुताशनम्। उदयन्मथादित्यमुपातिष्ठन्महातपाः॥
en: He then bathed in a river and poured libations on the sacred fire, and worshipped the rising Sun.

sa: नरनारायणावूचतुः धन्योऽस्यनुगृहीतोऽसि यत् ते दृष्टः स्वयं प्रभुः। न हि तं दृष्टवान् कश्चित् पद्मयोनिरपि स्वयम्॥
en: Nara and Narayana said You deserve very high encomiums, and highly favoured have you been, since you have seen the powerful Narayana himself. None else, not even Brahman himself who has sprung from the primal lotus, has been able to see him.

sa: नास्य भक्तात् प्रियतरो लोके कश्चन विद्यते। ततः स्वयं दर्शितवान् स्वमात्मानं द्विजोत्तम॥
en: There exists no one in the universe who is dearer to him than one that worships him with devotion. It is, therefore, O best of twice-born ones, that he showed himself to you!

sa: स रक्षमाणस्त्वण्डानि कुलिङ्गानां धृतव्रतः। तथैव तस्थौ धर्मात्मा निर्विचेष्टः समाहितः॥
en: Firmly observing his vows, the righteous Rishi continued to hold and protect those eggs by standing on that very spot perfectly motionless and immersed in Yoga meditation.

sa: ततः स सुचिरं दृष्ट्वा स्पृहालग्नेन चक्षुषा। मृगमालोक्य हिंसायां स्वर्गवासं समर्थयत्॥
en: Seeing (that spectacle) for a long time, with longing eyes, and seeing the deer and thinking that living in heaven can be acquired by only slaughter, he approved (of it).

sa: अण्डेभ्यस्त्वथ पुष्टेभ्यः प्राजायन्त शकुन्तकाः। व्यवर्धन्त च तत्रैव न चाकम्पत जाजलिः॥
en: When in the course of time the eggs became mature and young ones came out, they began to grow up in that nest, for Jajali moved not in the least.

sa: निपानानीव गोभ्योऽपि क्षेत्रे कुल्ये च भारत। स्मृतिर्हि शाश्वते धर्मो विप्रहीणो न दृश्यते॥
en: Like the small ponds at which cattle drink or the shallow canals along cultivated fields, that dry up very soon, the eternal practices laid down in the Smrities, falling into discontinuance, at last disappear for good.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मोक्षः पितामहेनोक्त उपायान्नानुपायतः। तमुपायं यथान्यायं श्रोतुमिच्छामि भारत॥
en: Yudhisthira said You have said, O grand-father, that Liberation is to be acquired by means and not otherwise. I wish to hear duly what those means are.

sa: प्रजनाद्यभिनिर्वृत्ताः सर्वे प्राणभृतो जनाः। प्रजनं चाप्युतान्यत्र न कथंचन विद्यते॥
en: All living creatures consider the procreation of offspring as a root of great happiness. The procreation of children, however, becomes impossible in any other mode of life.

sa: इमानि हि प्राणयन्ति सृजन्त्युत्तारयन्ति च। न धर्मः परिपाठेन शक्यो भारत वेदितुम्॥
en: All these embodied creatures, it seems, take birth, exist, and renounce their bodies, of their own nature. Duty and its opposite, therefore, cannot be determined, O Bharata, by study of the scriptures alone.

sa: ततोऽग्निमुपसंहृत्य ब्राह्मण विधिना मुनिः। ऐन्द्राग्नेयेन विधिना चळं श्रपयत स्वयम्॥
en: Lighting up a fire according to the Brahma rites, the ascetic, in pursuance of the rites of Aindragneya, began himself to cook that meat into sacrificial Charu.

sa: यदा नियतिदौर्बल्यमथैषामेव रोचते॥ न ह्यत्यन्तं बलवन्तो भवन्ति सुखिनोऽपि वा।
en: When, however, ill luck overtakes, these men they the approve of this injunction. Again, they who surpass others in strength or power do not necessarily become happy.

sa: धूतपाप: स तेजस्वी लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः। कामक्रोधौ वशे कृत्वा निनीषेद् ब्रह्मणः पदम्॥
en: When one becomes purged of sins and possessed of energy and abstemious in diet and the master of his senses, one then, having conquered both desire and anger, seeks to attain to Brahma.

sa: निर्वाणं सर्वधर्माणां निवृत्तिः परमा स्मृता। तस्मान्निवृत्तिमापन्नश्चरेत् सर्वाङ्गनिर्वृतः॥
en: The highest Renunciation is the annihilation of all duties and acts. Hence, by adopting Renunciation one should act in complete happiness.

sa: स्नाह्यालभ पिब प्राश जुहुध्यग्नीन् यजेत्यपि। ब्रवीहि शृणु चापीति विवश: कार्यते परैः॥
en: Bathe, touch, drink, eat, pour libations on the fire, celebrate sacrifices, speak, hear,these are the words which kings have to hear from others and hearing them have to serve those that utter them.

sa: अर्जयित्वा धनं पूर्वं दारुणैरपि कर्मभिः। भवेत् सर्वातिथिः पश्चात् स राजन् केतनक्षः॥
en: That man who having acquired riches by foul or cruel means subsequently spends it in worshipping the gods and performing the duties of hospitality, becomes worthy, O king, of being invited to Shraddhas.

sa: पितॄणां च महाभाग सततं संशितव्रत। विविधानां च भूतानां त्वमुपास्यो भविष्यसि॥
en: I further assured him that he would be an object of worship with all the gods and Asuras, all the Rishis and Pitris, and the various creatures forming the creation.

sa: प्राप्ते चाह्निककाले तु मध्यदेशगते रवौ। दंष्ट्राविलग्नांस्त्रीन् पिण्डान् विधाय सहसा प्रभुः।१४॥ स्थापयामास वै पृथ्वयां कुशानास्तीर्य नारद। स तेष्वात्मानमुद्दिश्य पित्र्यं चक्रे यथाविधि॥
en: When the Sun reached the meridian, and the hour, therefore, came for saying the morning prayers, the powerful Lord, suddenly shaking off thrce balls of mud from his tusk, placed them upon the Earth, O Narada, having previously spread powerful Vishnu dedicated those balls of mud to his own self, according to the rites laid down in the eternal ordinance.

sa: त्रयो मूर्तिविहीना वै पिण्डमूतिधरास्त्विमे। भवन्तु पितरो लोके मया सृष्टाः सनातनाः॥
en: Let these three that are of no particular shape, and that are only round, come to be considered as Pitris in the world! Thus do I create the eternal Pitris.

sa: प्रोष्य वर्षसहस्रं तु नरनारायणाश्रमे। श्रुत्वा भगवदाख्यानं दृष्ट्वा च हरिमव्ययम्॥ हिमवन्तं जगामाशु यत्रास्य स्वक आश्रमः।
en: Having lived for a full thousand years in the hermitage of Nara and Narayana, having seen the immutable Hari, and heard the excellent discourse having Narayana for its theme, the celestial Rishi went to his own hermitage on the breast of Himavat.

sa: पाणिभ्यां चैव जग्राह तान्यश्रूणि जनेश्वरः। मानवानां हितार्थाय ययाचे पुनरेव ह॥
en: Without suffering her tears, however, to fall down, she held them, O king, in her joinedhands. She then solicited the Self-born, moved by the desire of doing good to mankind.

sa: तव तेजोऽग्निना देव प्रजा दह्यन्ति सर्वशः। ता दृष्ट्वा मम कारुण्यं मा कुष्यासां जगत्प्रभो॥
en: By the fire born of your anger, illustrious one, all the created beings are being burnt. Seeing them placed in such a condition, I am filled with compassion. Do not be angry with them, O maker of the universe.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदोऽथ तपोधनः आख्यानमिदमाचष्ट पुत्रशोकापहं तदा॥
en: Having heard him Narada, endued with wealth of penances, then recited to him the following narrative for removing his grief consequent on the death of his son.

sa: अप्स्वेव शयनं चक्रे निद्रायोगमुपागतः॥ जगतश्चिन्तयन् सृष्टिं चित्रां बहुगुणोद्भवाम्।
en: Entering into Yoga-sleep, he lays himself down on the waters. He then thinks of the Creation of the Universe of various phenomena and qualities.

sa: ततो हृतेषु वेदेषु ब्रह्मा कश्मलमाविशत्। ततो वचनमीशानं प्राह वेदैविनाकृतः॥
en: Seeing the Vedas forcibly taken away from him, Brahman became stricken with grief. Robbed of the Vedas thus, Brahman then addressed the Supreme Lord in these words.

sa: अविशेषाणि भूतानि गुणांश्च जहतो मुनेः। सुखेनापोह्यते दुःखं भास्करेण तमो यथा॥
en: Like the Sun removing darkness, happiness removes the sorrows of that Yogin who gets over both the gross and the subtile elements, as also the intellectual principle and the Unmanifest.

sa: निष्प्रचारं मनः कृत्वा प्रतिष्ठाप्य च सर्वशः। यामयं लभते तुष्टिं सा न शक्याऽऽत्मनोऽन्यथा॥
en: The pleasure which a man enjoys by governing his mind from roving in all directions and fixing it entirely on the Soul is such that its like cannot be acquired by one through any other means.

sa: आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्। तद्वत् कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामः॥
en: That person into whose mind all sorts of desire enter like various rivers falling into the ocean without being able to increase its limits by their discharge, acquires equaniinity, but not he who cherishes desire for all worldly objects.

sa: न च मां ते ददृशिरे न च द्रक्ष्यति कथश्चन। ऋते ौकान्तिकश्रेष्ठात् त्वं चैवैकान्तिकोत्तमः॥
en: Their wishes, however, were not fulfilled. Excepting those who are devoted to with wholly and solely, no else can see me. As regards you, you are verily the foremost of all persons devoted to me with all their souls.

sa: निरोङ्कारेण यद् भुक्तं सशस्त्रेण च भारत। दुरात्मना च यद् भुक्तं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: Food that has been eaten by a person incompetent to utter the syllable Om, or that has been eaten by a person bearing arms, O Bharata, or that has been caten by a wicked person, should be known as due to Rakshasas.

sa: वित्रास्यमानाः सुकृतो न कामाद् जन्ति दुष्कृतीन्। सुकृतेनैव राजानो भूयिष्ठं शासते प्रजाः॥
en: Subjects can be made honest by, being only terrorized. Good kings never kill the wicked from motives of retribution. Good kings succeed in ruling their subjects properly with the help of good conduct.

sa: यदाहमेव जानामि न मृत्युस्तिष्ठतीति ह। सोऽहं कथं प्रतीक्षिष्ये ज्ञानेनापिहितश्चरन्॥
en: When I know that Death does not wait here for any one how can I possibly wait thus covered in a sheath of Ignorance and attending affairs?

sa: श्वः कार्यमद्य कुर्वीत पूर्वाह्ने चापराह्निकम्। न हि प्रतीक्षते मृत्युः कृतं वास्य न वा कृतम्॥
en: What is kept for being done tomorrow should be done to-day; and what one thinks of doing in the afternoon should be done in the forenoon. Death does not wait for a man whether he has, or has not done his acts.

sa: कर्णावाकाशपाताले ललाटं भूतधारिणी। गङ्गा सरस्वती श्रोण्यौ भ्रुवावास्तां महोदधी॥
en: The regions above and below became his two ears. The Earth became his forehead. The two rivers Ganga and Sarasvati became his two eye-brows,

sa: कृते धर्मे भवेत् प्रीतिरिह प्रेत्य च शाश्वती। मोहेन हि समाविष्टः पुत्रदारार्थमुद्यतः॥
en: By acquiring virtue one is sure to acquire eternal happiness both in this world and in the next. Overpowered by folly one is up and doing on behalf of his sons and wives.

sa: व्यास उवाच मनो विसृजते भावं बुद्धिरध्यवसायिनी। हृदयं प्रियाप्रिये वेद त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना॥
en: Vyasa said The mind creates innumerable ideas. The Understanding, differentiates things and ascertains their true nature. The heart discriminates which is pleasant and which unpleasant. There are the three forces which produce acts.

sa: अधिकारे यदनृतं यच्च राजसु पैशुनम्। गुरोचालीककरणं तुल्यं तद् ब्रह्महत्यया॥
en: To utter untruth in a court of justice to behave deceitfully towards the king, to act falsely towards preceptors and elders, are considered as equivalent to Brahmanicide.

sa: नारायणपरा वेदा यज्ञा नारायणात्मकाः। तपो नारायणपरं नारायणपरा गतिः॥
en: The Vedas are the soul of Narayana, all sacrifices are the form of Narayana, Penances are Narayana and the highest end is also Narayana.

sa: शुक उवाच अध्यात्म विस्तरेणेह पुनरेव वदस्व मे। यदध्यात्म यथा वेद भगवनृषिसत्तम्॥
en: Shuka said O illustrious one, O foremost of Rishis, once again describe to me fully the subject bearing on soul. Tell me what, in deed, is spiritual topic and whence does it come?

sa: तत्त्वमेको महायोगी हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः। ब्रह्मादीनां स लोकानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्॥ सांख्यानां योगिनां चापि यतीनामात्मवेदिनाम्। मनीषितं विजानाति केशवो न तु तस्य ते॥
en: Indeed, the powerful Narayana, endued with the highest Yoga-power, is the one subject of (enquiry). Keshava perfectly knows the thoughts of men including Brahman and the great Rishis, of those that are Sankhyas and Yogins, of those that are Yatis, and of those, generally, that are conversant with the Soul, but none of these can know what his thoughts are.

sa: चतुष्पदी हि निःश्रेणी ब्रह्मण्येषा प्रतिष्ठिता। एतामारुह्य निःश्रेणी ब्रह्मलोके महीयते॥
en: The four modes of life form a ladder or flight of steps. That fight attaches to Brahma. By ascending that flight one reaches the region of Brahma.

sa: अनालम्भे ह्यदोषः स्यादालम्भे दोष उत्तमः। एवं स्थितस्य शास्त्रस्य दुर्विज्ञेयं बलाबलम्॥
en: If abstention from acts produces merit, then their performance must be highly reprehensible. When the scriptures say this, the strength or weakness of particular sayings must be difficult to determine.

sa: यथावत् सम्प्रवर्तन्ते यस्मिस्तिष्ठन्ति वा विभो। तत् तेऽनुपूर्व्या व्याख्यास्ये तदिहैकमनाः शृणु॥
en: Listen to me with rapt attention. I shall in their due order, describe to you, O powerful Danava, as to how creatures follow action and how they give up action.

sa: ततः प्रवर्तिता सम्यक् तपोविद्भिर्द्विजातिभिः। शब्दे चार्थे च हेतो च एषा प्रथमसर्गजा॥
en: On account of the entrance of the goddess of speech into their bodies, those Rishis, well conversant with penances, succeeded in composing that foremost of works in respect of words, senses and reason.

sa: तस्य तेजोमयः सूर्यो मनश्चन्द्रमसि स्थितम्। बुद्धिर्ज्ञानगता नित्यं रसस्त्वप्सु प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: The light of His eye is the Sun, and His mind is in the Moon. His Understanding lives always in Knowledge, and His tongue is in Water.

sa: ततो महोदधिश्चैव प्राप्तवान् धर्ममुत्तमम्। अन्तर्दधे ततो भूयो नारायणसमाहितः॥
en: From those Rishis this excellent religion was acquired by the great Ocean. It once more disappeared from the universe and became merged into Narayana.

sa: एवं परिमितं कालमाचरन् संशितव्रतः। आसीनो हि रहस्येको गच्छेदक्षरसात्मताम्॥
en: Practising austere vows, the Yogin, who acts thus for six months seated by himself on a lonely spot, becomes at one with the Indestructible.

sa: चक्षुःश्रोत्रे च मनसा मनोवाचं च कर्मणा। अप्रमादाद् भयं जह्याद् दम्भं प्राज्ञोपसेवनात्॥
en: One should protect his eyes and ears by the help of his mind, and his mind and speech by his acts, One should avoid fear by carefulness, and pride by attending the wise.

sa: व्यास उवाच पृच्छतस्तव सत्पुत्र यथावदिह तत्त्वतः। सांख्यज्ञानेन संयुक्तं यदेतत् कीर्तितं मया॥
en: Vyasa said O excellent son, accosted by you. I have told you truly what the answer to your question should be according to the doctrine of Knowledge as explained in the Sankhya system.

sa: शतं सहस्राणि चतुर्दशेह परागतिर्जीवगणस्य दैत्य आरोहणं तत्कृतमेव विद्धि स्थानं तथा निःसरणं च तेषाम्॥
en: The stages of existence, O Daitya, through which individual soul must pass are not unlimited. They are fourteen hundreds of thousands in number. In consequence of them individual soul, ascends, stays, and falls down as the case may be.

sa: ऊर्णनाभेर्यथा चक्रं छिद्रं सोमं प्रपश्यति॥ तथैव च सहस्रांशुं सप्तरात्रेण मृत्युभाक्।
en: One who sees the lunar disc full of holes like spider's web, or one who sees the solar disc to have similar holes, has but one week more to live.

sa: तपोधर्मेण संयुक्तस्तपोनित्यः सुसंशितः। तेन सर्वानवाप्नोति कामान् यान् मनसेच्छति॥
en: Given to the practice of penances, firm in them, and rigid in their observance, one acquires the fruition of all desires by penances alone.

sa: नारदेन सुसम्प्राप्तः सरहस्यः ससंग्रहः। एष धर्मो जगन्नाथात् साक्षान्नारायणान्नृप॥
en: The celestial Rishi Narada got it from that Lord of universe, viz., Narayana himself, O king, with all its mysteries and abstract of details.

sa: भूतानां जन्म सर्वेषां विविधानां चतुर्विधम्। जरायुजाण्डजोद्भिज्जस्वेदजं चोपलक्षयेत्॥
en: All the sorts of created things have four kinds of birth. They are viviparous, oviparous, vegetables, and those born of filth.

sa: हरिरेव हि क्षेत्रज्ञो निर्ममो निष्कलस्तथा। जीवश्च सर्वभूतेषु पञ्चभूतगुणातिगः॥
en: Hari is Himself the Kshetrajna (Soul). He is without parts. He is the Individual Soul in all creatures, getting over the five primal elements.

sa: विपरीतमतो यत् तु तदव्यक्तमुदाहृतम्। द्वावात्मानौ च वेदेषु सिद्धान्तेष्वप्युदाहृतौ॥
en: What does not possess these attributes is said to to be Unmanifest. Two Souls are mentioned in the Vedas and in their auxiliary sciences.

sa: इत्येतदाख्यातमहीनसत्त्व नारायणस्येह बलं मया ते॥
en: Thus, O you of great power, I have described to you the greatness of Narayana.

sa: देवं परमकं ब्रह्म श्वेतं चन्द्राभमच्युतम्। यत्र चैकान्तिनो यान्ति नारायणपरायणाः॥
en: Those persons who are whole-mindedly devoted to Narayana in the end, that greatest of gods, identical with Brahma, pure in complexion, effulgent like the moon, and immutable.

sa: जलरूपमिवाकाशे तथैवात्मनि पश्यति। अपां व्यतिक्रमे चास्य वह्निरूपं प्रकाशते ।१९।।
en: For then the Yogin sees within himself, in the sky of his heart, the form of Water. After the disappearance of water, the form of Fire appears.

sa: किं त्वस्याः परमं रूपं जीर्णमासीत् कथं पुनः। कन्यारूपमिहाद्यैवं किमिवात्रोत्तरं भवेत्॥
en: She is highly beautiful. Why did decrepitude hide her beauty so long? At present she looks like a beautiful maiden. I do not know what forin she may assume hereafter.

sa: धूतपाप्मा च मेधावी लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः॥ कामक्रोधौ वशे कृत्वा निनीषेद् ब्रह्मण: पदम्।
en: One gifted with intelligence should be abstemious in diet and should conquer his senses. Indeed, having subdued both lust and anger and having dissipated all his sins, he should try to attain Brahina.

sa: एवं धर्मेण वर्तेत क्रियां शिष्टवदाचरेत्॥ असंरोधेन भूतानां वृत्तिं लिप्सेत वै द्विजः।
en: A Brahmana should follow the duties laid down in the Vedas. He should do all his works like a good man of controlled soul. He should acquire his livelihood without injuring any creature.

sa: केशविक्रयिका राजन् विषविक्रयिकाश्च ये। क्षीरविक्रयिकाश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who live by selling hair, they who live by selling poisons, and they who live by selling milk have to sink in hell.

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य वृत्रहा कुरुनन्दन॥ स्वर्गायाभिमुखः प्रायाल्लोकानां हितकाम्यया।
en: A little while after, O you of Kuru's race, the killer of Vritra, for the behoof of the three worlds, was proceeding towards heaven.

sa: ये च मुक्ता भवन्तीह नरा भरतसत्तम। तेषां लक्षणमेतद्धि तच्छ्वेतद्वीपवासिनाम्॥
en: O chief of Bharata's race, the characteristics of those men that become liberated the same as those by which the inhabitants of the White Island are distinguished?

sa: सांकृतिश्च तथाऽऽत्रेय: शिष्येभ्यो ब्रह्म निर्गुणम्। उपदिश्य महातेजा गतो लोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: Having given instruction to his disciples on the subject of Impersonal Brahma, Sanskriti of Atri's race, endued with great energy, proceeded to the regions of great felicity.

sa: स्व्युवाच नानिलोऽग्निर्न वरुणो न चान्ये त्रिदशा द्विज॥ प्रियाः स्त्रीणां यथा कामोरतिशीला हि योषितः।
en: The lady said The very gods of wind and fire and water, or the other celestials, O twice born one are not so agreeable to women as the god of love. Indeed women are greatly fond of sexual union.

sa: प्रीते तु त्वयि धर्मज्ञ सर्वलेकेश्वर प्रभो। शक्रादपगमिष्यामि निवासं संविधत्स्व मे॥
en: As you have been pleased with me, O righteous Lord, O powerful Master of all the worlds, I shall surely leave Shakra! But grant me an abode to live in.

sa: यत् पृथिव्यां पुण्यतमं विद्यात् स्थानं तदावसेत्। यतेत तस्मिन् प्रामाण्यं गन्तुं यशसि चोत्तमे॥
en: He should live for good in that place which he may ascertain to be the most sacred spot on earth, and he should try, in all matters leading to fame, for attaining to an eminent position.

sa: स ददर्श द्विधा कृत्वा पर्वताग्रं शुकं गतम्॥ शशंसुर्ऋषयस्तत्र कर्म पुत्रस्य तत् तदा।
en: Proceeding along the same way, Vyasa saw the mountain summit rent in two parts and through which Shuka has passed. Meeting the Island-born ascetic, the Rishis began to describe to him the achievements of his own.

sa: स तत्र काञ्चनं दिव्यं सर्वरत्नमयं गृहम्। ददर्शाद्भुतसंकाशं धनदस्य गृहाद् वरम्॥
en: He then saw a beautiful palace made of gold and adorned with all sorts of gems. Of wonderful structure, that palace surpassed the palace of Kubera himself in every respect.

sa: तमो हृष्टविधं हित्वा जहौ पञ्चविधं रजः। ततः सत्त्वं जहौ धीमांस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Renouncing also the eight kinds of Tamas, he dismissed the five kinds of Rajas. Gifted with great intelligence, he the renounced the attribute of Sattva. All this seemed extremely wonderful.

sa: व्यास उवाच अनाद्यन्तमजं दिव्यमजरं ध्रुवमव्ययम्। अप्रतर्व्यमविज्ञेयं ब्रह्माने सम्प्रवर्तते॥
en: Vyasa said Only Brahma, who is without beginning without end, unborn, effulgent, above decay, immutable, indestructible, inconceivable and transcending knowledge, exists before the Creation.

sa: पापं कृत्वाभिमन्येत नाहमस्मीति पूरुषः। तच्चिकीर्षति कल्याणं श्रद्दधानोऽनसूयकः॥
en: One should not brag after having committed sin. By having faith and by freeing one's self from malice, one acquires blessedness.

sa: अथास्य बुद्धिरभवत् पुनरन्या तदा किला सृष्टाः प्रजा इमाः सर्वा ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना॥ दैत्यदानवगन्धर्वरक्षोगणसमाकुला। जाता हीयं वसुमती भाराकान्ता तपस्विनी।॥
en: After the work of Creation, however, had been done by Brahman, another thought arose in the mind of Narayana. Indeed,. He thought thus,-Brahman, otherwise called Parameshthi, has created all these creatures, consisting of Daityas and Danavas and Gandharvas and Rakshasas. The helpless Earth has become loaded with the weight of creatures.

sa: पूर्वं हि कथितं श्रुत्वा भृगुभाषितमुत्तमम्। भरद्वाजस्य विप्रर्षस्ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्तमा॥ जाता परमधर्मिष्ठा दिव्यसंस्थानसंस्थिता। ततो भूयस्तु पृच्छामि तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: Having heard before this the excellent discourse of Bhrigu to the twice-born sage Bharadvaja, which you did recite, my understanding, shorn of ignorance, has become greatly attached to yoga, and withdrawn from worldly objects rests upon heavenly purity. I ask you about the subject, therefore, once more. You should describe it to me fully.

sa: ततो द्वैपायनसुतं बहुमानात् समन्ततः। कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वा निरीक्षन्ते स्म देवताः॥
en: All the gods also, of both sexes, joining their hands, paid respect to the son of Island bonr Rishi and looked act him with wonder and reverence.

sa: याज्ञवक्ल्य उवाच सांख्यज्ञानं मया प्रोक्तं योगज्ञानं निबोध मे। यथाश्रुतं यथादृष्टं तत्त्वेन नृपसत्तम॥
en: Yajnavalkya said, I have already spoken to you of the science of the Sankhyas. Hear now as I truly describe the science of the Yogins as heard and seen my me, O best of kings. are

sa: गङ्गा च सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वतीर्थजलोद्भवा। पर्युपासत तं देवं रूपिणी कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Ganga, also, that foremost of all Rivers and originating from all sacred waters in the universe, waited there in her embodied form, O son of Kuru, upon that illustrious gods.

sa: यथाशक्ति यथान्यायं पूजां वै चक्रिरे तदा। पुष्पवर्षेच दिव्यैस्तमवचक्रुर्दिवौकसः॥
en: All creatures, according to the ordinance and according to their power, adored him with respect. The celestials poured showers of celestial flowers upon him.

sa: अनेन ते महाभाग प्रतिषेधेन भागतः। अतीव दुःखमुत्पन्नं वेपथुश्च ममानघ॥
en: On account, however, of this disability regarding a share I am filled with great grief, O sinless one, and a treinour fills me from head to foot.

sa: व्यवसायेन लोकांस्त्रीन् सर्वान् सोऽथ विचिन्तयन्। आस्थितो दीर्घमध्वानं पावकार्कसमप्रभः॥
en: Gifted with the splendour of fire or the Sun, Shuka then considered the three worlds as one Brahma, and went along that lengthy path.

sa: कर्मान्तविरते लोके अस्तं गच्छति भास्करे। गम्यतां स्वमधिष्ठानं सुतस्नेहं विसृज्य वै॥
en: At this hour when men are about to terminate their daily labours, the Sun is retiring to the setting hills. Go to your homes, renouncing this love for the child.

sa: ततस्तुतोष भगवान् हरिस्तेनास्य कर्मणा॥ तपसा च सुतप्तेन यमेन नियमेन च।
en: For that act of the Rishi, the illustrious Hari became pleased with him, as also for his wellperformed penances, his and observances, and his control of the senses or passions.

sa: पुनस्तिष्ये च सम्प्राप्ते कुरवो नाम भारताः॥ भविष्यन्ति महात्मानो राजानः प्रथिता भुवि।
en: When the Kali age will set in, certain princes of Bharata's line, named Kauravas, will take their birth from you. They will be celebrated over Earth as great princes ruling over powerful kingdoms.

sa: तस्मिन् पतितमात्रे च स्वेदबिन्दौ तदा भुवि॥ प्रादुर्बभूव सुमहानग्निः कालानलोपमः।
en: When the drop of sweat fell down on the Earth, there immediately appeared a blazing fire resembling the conflagration that appears at the end of the cycle.

sa: तेषां त्वत्तः प्रसूतानां कुलभेदो भविष्यति॥ परस्परविनाशार्थ त्वामृते द्विजसत्तम।
en: Born of you, dissension's will break out among them for their destruction at one another's hands during your absence, O foremost of twice-born ones.

sa: न तत्र पक्षिसंघातो न शब्दो नातिदर्शनम्। यत्र वैयासकिधीमान् योक्तुं समुपचक्रमे॥
en: In that spot where the intelligent son of Vyasa sat prepared to practise Yoga, there were no flocks of birds, no sound, and no sight that was repulsive or fearful.

sa: विनिश्चित्याथ च तदा विक्रोशन्तस्ततस्ततः। मृतमित्येव गच्छन्तो निराशास्तस्य दर्शने॥
en: Knowing very well that the child had died and giving up every hope to see him again, they began to go back, bewailing loudly.

sa: ऋषिभिः सह यास्यामि सौरं तेजोऽतिदुःसहम्॥ आपृच्छामि नगान् नागान् गिरिमुर्वी दिशो दिवम्। देवदानवगन्धर्वान् पिशाचोरगराक्षसान्॥। लोकेषु सर्वभूतानि प्रवेक्ष्यामि न संशयः।
en: I shall enter with the great Rishis the unbearable energy of the Sun, I declare to all creatures, these trees, these elephants, these mountains, the Earth herself, the several cardinal points, the sky, the gods, the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas, Uragas, and the Rakshasas, that I shall enter all creatures in the world.

sa: रविस्तु संतापयते लोकान् रश्मिभिरुल्बणैः। सर्वतस्तेज आदत्ते नित्यमक्षयमण्डलः॥ अतो मे रोचते गन्तुमादित्यं दीप्ततेजसम्।
en: The Sun warms all the worlds by means of his rays. His disc never suffers any diminution. Remaining unchanged, he drinks energy from all things. Hence, I wish to go into the Sun of blazing effulgence.

sa: पुण्यपापवियुक्तानां स्थानमाहुर्महात्मनाम्। शाश्वतं चाव्ययं चैवमक्षयं चामृतं च तत्॥
en: Those great persons who are above both virtue and sin, attain, it is said, to that place which is eternal, immutable, undecaying, and immortal.

sa: यत्राहं तत्र मत्कान्ता मद्विशिष्टा मदर्पणाः॥ सप्त देव्यो जयाष्टम्यो वासमेष्यन्ति तेऽष्टधा।
en: There where I live the seven other goddesses with Jaya for the eighth, who love me, who are inseparably associated with me, and who depend upon me, wish to live.

sa: बन्धूनां सुहृदां चैव भृत्यानां स्त्रीजनस्य च। अव्यक्तेष्वपराधेषु चिरकारी प्रशस्यते॥
en: When the offence is not distinctly proved against a relative, a friend, a servant, or a wife, he who thinks long before inflicting the punishment, is praised.

sa: ममान्तरात्मा तव च ये चान्ये देहिसंज्ञिताः। सर्वेषां साक्षिभूतोऽसौ न ग्राह्यः केनचित् क्वचित्॥
en: He is my inner soul. He is your inner soul. He is the omniscient Witness living within all embodied creatures and engaged in marking their acts. No one can grasp or comprehend him at any time.

sa: नास्मि वर्णोत्तमा जात्या न वैश्या नावरा तथा। तव राजन् सवर्णास्मि शुद्धयोनिरविप्लुता॥
en: Then, again, I am not superior to you in colour. Nor am I a Vaishya, nor a Shudra, I am, O king, of the same caste with you, born of a pure family.

sa: यथा दीपसहस्राणि दीपान्माः प्रकुर्वते। प्रकृतिस्तथा विकुरुते पुरुषस्य गुणान् बहून्॥
en: As men can light thousands of lamps from but a single lamp, similarly Nature, by change, multiplies into thousands of existent objects the (three) qualities of Purusha.

sa: रजश्च हि तमश्च त्वां स्पृशते न जितेन्द्रियम्॥ निष्प्रीतिं नष्टसंतापमात्मानं त्वमुपाससे।
en: The qualities of Darkness and Ignorance do not soil you, for you have conquered your senses. You wait only upon your soul which is divested of both joy and sorrow.

sa: सर्वलोको ह्ययं मन्ये बुद्ध्या परिगतस्त्वया॥ विहरन् सर्वतो मुक्तो न क्वचित् परिषज्जते।
en: With your understanding you have full understood the entire universe. Though you have enjoyed every sort of happiness, you were never attached to anything, and hence you have not been sullied by anything.

sa: को हि विश्वासमर्थेषु शरीरे वा शरीरभृत्॥ कर्तुमुत्सहते लोके दृष्ट्वा सम्प्रस्थितं जगत्।
en: Seeing all things in this universe as transient, who is there in it, endued with body, that would venture to place confidence on either his body or all the objects of his desire?

sa: सङ्गत्या जठरे न्यस्तं रेतोबिन्दुमचेतनम्। केन यत्नेन जीवन्तं गर्भ त्वमिह पश्यसि॥
en: By sexual intercourse, a drop of the seminal fluid that is inanimate, is cast into the womb. I ask you, through whose or what care is the embryo kept alive?

sa: अहमैन्द्राच्च्युतः स्थानात् त्वमिन्द्रः प्रकृतोदिवि॥ सुचित्रे जीवलोकेऽस्मिन्नुपास्यः कालपर्ययात्। किं हि कृत्वा त्वमिन्द्रोऽद्य किं वा कृत्वा वयं च्युताः।
en: You will then fall and your limbs will become as miserable as mine now even though I am endued with great energy. I have fallen away from the high place that is occupied by the king of the three worlds. You are not the real Indra in heaven.

sa: शोककाले शुचो मा त्वं हर्षकाले च मा हृषः॥ अतीतानागतं हित्वा प्रत्युत्पन्नेन वर्तय।
en: When the hour of sorrow comes, do not give way to it. Likewise, when the hour of joy comes, do not rejoice. Not thinking of both the past and the future, live contentedly with the present.

sa: ईश्वरं सम्प्रपद्यन्ते द्विजा भवितभावनाः। सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि यो भक्तः परमेश्वरे॥
en: Even if a person enjoys every pleasure and luxury, yet if he be devoted to the Supreme Deity he is considered equal to hermits of purified souls.

sa: भवात्मकं सम्परिवर्तमान न मादृशः संज्वरं जातु कुर्यात्। इष्टान् भोगान् नानुरुध्येत् सुखं वा न चिन्तयेहुःखमभ्यागतं वा॥
en: One like me would never adopt worldly life with all its changes and painful incidents. Such a one would not care for objects of enjoyments, and would not think at all of the happiness which they yield, or, indeed, of the griefs that come on.

sa: इष्टदारवियुक्ताश्च पुत्रशोकान्वितास्तथा। दह्यमानाः स्म शोकेन गृहं गच्छन्ति नित्यशः॥
en: Shorn of wives and dear ones and filled with sorrow for children, men leave this spot every day with aggrieved hearts for returning home.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच अतिभारोऽथ तस्यैव भारावतरणं महत्। पराश्वासकरं वाक्यमिदं मे भवतः श्रुतम्॥
en: I have heard these words of yours that are so consoling, with as much satisfaction as is experienced by a person heavily loaded when that load is taken off his head or shoulders.

sa: भूतानामपरः कश्चिद्धिंसायां सततोत्थितः। वञ्चनायां च लोकस्य स सुखेष्वेव जीर्यते॥
en: Some one else, who is always ready to injure all creatures, and who is engaged in imposing on all the world, is seen to languish in happiness.

sa: व्यत्ययो ह्ययमत्यन्तं पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः। जातान् माजरयति निमेषान् नावतिष्ठते॥
en: The continued succession of the lighted and the dark fortnights is destroyed all mortal creatures without stopping for even a moment in this work.

sa: वागध्यात्ममिति प्राहुर्यथा श्रुतिनिदर्शिनः। वक्तव्यमधिभूतं तु वह्निस्तत्राधिदैवतम्॥
en: The organs of speech are spiritual; the words uttered by them are Elemental; and Agni is their Accidental.

sa: आधिभिर्व्याधिभिश्चैव वर्जितस्त्वं भविष्धसि॥ पादाच्चतुर्थात् सम्भूत आत्मा यस्मान्मुने तव। त्वं भविष्यस्यनुपमो जन्म वै सफलं कुरु॥
en: You will also be freed from all sorts of affliction and disease. And since, O ascetic this body of yours has originated from the fourth foot of Dharma, (viz., Truth), you will be peerless on Earth. Do you make your life fruitful.

sa: तद्रोषं सहजं त्यक्त्वा त्वमेनं द्रष्टुमर्हसि। आशाच्छेदेन तस्याद्य नात्मानं दग्धुमर्हसि॥
en: Renouncing that anger which is natural to you, you should go and see that Brahmana. You should not allows yourself to be consumed by disappointing that Brahmana.

sa: नाग उवाच अभिमानैर्न मानो मे जातिदोषेण वै महान्। रोषः संकल्पजः साध्वि दग्धो वागग्निना त्वया॥
en: The Naga said I had no arrogance. On account, however, of my birth, my pride was considerable. Of anger which is born of desire, O blessed lady, I have none. It has all been consumed by the fire of your excellent instructions.

sa: अब्रुवन् वाति सुरभिर्गन्धः सुमनसां शुचिः। तथैवाव्याहरन् भाति विमलो भानुरम्बरे॥
en: Flowers shed their pure and sweet odour without speaking of their own excellence. Likewise, the effulgent Sun scatters his shining rays in the sky in perfect silence.

sa: न च रोषादहं साध्वि पश्येयमधिकं तमः। तस्य वक्तव्यतां यान्ति विशेषेण भुजङ्गमाः॥
en: I do not see, O blessed lady, any darkness that is thicker than anger. On account, however of the Nagas having excess of anger, they have become objects of reproach with all persons.

sa: तमप्रतिबलं भीममाकाशं ग्रसतेऽऽत्मना। आकाशमप्यभिनदन्मनो ग्रसति चाधिकम्॥
en: Then Space of inmeasurable existent devours that Wind of transcendent power. Then mind cheerfully devours that immeasurable Space.

sa: सर्वे विकृतदेहाश्चाप्यस्मिन् देशे सुदारुणे। युष्मान् प्रधर्षयिष्यन्ति विकृता मांसभोजिनः॥१००।
en: All those creatures of dreadful forms which live in this fearful place, all those grim-visaged animals that haunt this desert, will soon attack you.

sa: जामदग्न्यश्च कौन्तेयमिदं धर्मभृतां वरः। ऋषिमध्ये स्थितः प्राह ज्वलन्निव दिवाकरः॥
en: Then Jamadagni's son, that foremost of all pious persons, effulgent like the Sun in the midst of that assembly of Rishis said to the son of Kunti.

sa: अशुचीन् यत्र पश्येत ब्राह्मणान् वृत्तिकर्शितान्। त्यजेत् तद् राष्ट्रमासन्नमुपसृष्टमिवामिषम्॥
en: One should leave that kingdom, like poisoned meat, where one sees Brahmanas compelled to follow unholy practices, by want of the means of life.

sa: देव्या प्रणोदितो देवः कारुण्यार्दीकृतेक्षणः। ततस्तानाह मनुजान वरदोऽस्मीति शङ्करः॥ ते प्रत्यूचुरिदं वाक्यं दुःखिताः प्रणताः स्थिताः। एकपुत्रविहीनानां सर्वेषां जीवितार्थिनाम्॥ पुत्रस्य नो जीवदानाज्जीवितं दातुमर्हसि।
en: Addressing the kinsmen of the dead child, the god said,-I am Shankara the granter of boons!-With hearts laden with grief, those men laid themselves low before the great god and said to him in reply,-Bereft of this our only child, all of us are on the brink of death. Be you pleased to grant us life by granting life to this our son.

sa: सक्तबुद्धिरशान्तात्मा न शक्यं तच्चिकित्सितुम्। स्नेहपाशसितो मूढो न स मोक्षाय कल्पते॥
en: The understanding that is attached to worldly objects and the longing mind baffle all skilful treatment. The ignorant man who is bound is the fetters of affection cannot acquire Liberation.

sa: सत्यमार्जवमक्रोधमनसूयां दमं तपः। अहिंसां चानृशंस्यं च विधिवत् परिपालय॥
en: Do you duly observe truth and sincerity, and freedom from anger and malice, and selfcontrol and penances, and the duties of benevolence and mercy.

sa: सत्ये तिष्ठ रतो धर्मे हित्वा सर्वमनार्जवम्। देवतातिथिशेषेण मात्रां प्राणस्य संलिह॥
en: Rest you on truth, firmly devoted to virtue, renouncing all sorts of insincerity and deceit. Do you support your life on the remnants of food after feeding gods and guests.

sa: ततः स राजा तच्छुत्वा वचनं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। अवाप्य परमं हर्षं तथेति प्राह बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Hearing the words of those Brahmavadins, the wise king was delighted at heart, and said, Be it so! The king sought a boon of Do you, O Agni, be pleased to remain always with us here!

sa: सुदर्शनस्तु रूपेण पूर्णेन्दुसदृशोपमः। शिशुरेवाध्यगात् सर्वं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम्॥
en: Sudarshana, also, was, as beautiful as the full moon, and even in his childhood he acquired a knowledge of the supreme and eternal Brahma.

sa: एतदाहुः समाहारं क्षेत्रमध्यात्मचिन्तकाः। स्थितो मनसि यो भावः स वै क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते॥
en: Those who know thoroughly well the character of Soul and non-Soul, say that this sum total of the senses, etc.,) is body. That existent thing which rests, upon the mind is called Soul.

sa: ततस्त्वाश्रममागम्य स पावकसुतस्तदा। तां व्याजहारौघवतीं क्वासि यातेति चासकृत्॥
en: When the son of Pavaka returned to his own asylum, he called out for Oghavati by name, and repeatedly exclaimed Where are you gone?

sa: अलं परिग्रहेणेह दोषवान् हि परिग्रहः। कृमिर्हि कोषकारस्तु बध्यते स परिग्रहात्॥
en: No need of attaching yourself to earthly objects. Attachment to earthly objects produces evil. The silk-worm that forms a cocoon round itself is at last destroyed by its own deed.

sa: सर्वमुच्छेदनिष्ठं स्यात् पश्य चैतद् द्विजोत्तम! अप्रमत्तः प्रमत्तो वा किं विशेषं करिष्यति॥
en: See, O foremost of the twice-born, that if liberation be such, then all religious acts and vows terminate only in annihilation? Of what use would then the distinction be between heedfulness and heedlessness.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं ह्येतयोर्मूलं कृतान्तैतिह्ययोरपि। प्रत्यक्षेणागमो भिन्नः कृतान्तो वा न किञ्चन॥
en: Direct evidence is the basis of both inference and the scriptures. The scriptures can be contradicted by direct evidence. As to inference its evidence is not much.

sa: आश्रमं मम सम्प्राप्तस्त्रिलोकेशः पुरंदरः। अतिथिव्रतमास्थाय ब्राह्मणं रूपमास्थितः॥
en: The lord of the three worlds, viz., Purandara, came to my asylum, in the guise of a Brahmana asking for hospitality.

sa: वाग्भिश्च भगवान् येन देवसेनाग्रगः प्रभुः। स्तुतः प्रीतमनाश्चासीच्छापाञ्चैनममुञ्चत॥ ध्रुवस्यौत्तानपादस्य ब्रह्मर्षीणां तथैव च। मध्यं ज्वलति यो नित्यमुदीचीमाश्रितो दिशम्॥
en: He prayed to the glorious and powerful Indra who was pleased with him and freed him from a curse. Remaining on the northern side of the sky, he sheds his lustre from a position in the midst of the seven twiceborn Rishis, and Dhruva the son of Uttanpada.

sa: वलीपलितसंयोगे कायँ वैवर्ण्यमेव च। कुब्जभावं च जरया यः पश्यति स मुच्यते॥
en: That man becomes liberated who always recollects that this body, when possessed by decrepitude, becomes assailed by wrinkless and white hairs and leanness and paleness of complexion and a bending of the form.

sa: स गच्छेदभ्यनुज्ञातो भवता यदि मन्यसे। आनर्तनगरी वीरस्तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: Let him go, if you think it proper, to the city of the Anaritas! You should, O hero, grant him permission.

sa: निवेदयामास तदा शिवायामिततेजसे। देवश्रेष्ठाय रुद्राय सौम्याय बहुरूपिणे॥
en: Kuvera reported the matter to Shiva of great energy, that first of gods, fierce and amiable, and endued with various forms.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा ततः क्रुद्धो महायोगी महेश्वरः। संरक्तनयनो राजशूलमादाय तस्थिवान्॥
en: Hearing these words, Maheshvara of Supreme Yoga-powers became filled with ire. His eyes, O king, became blood-red, and taking up his lance he waited.

sa: प्रकाशस्तपसो ज्ञानं लोके संशब्दितं तपः। रजस्तमोघ्नं यत् कर्म तपसस्तत् स्वलक्षणम्॥
en: The result of yoga is Knowledge. Yoga is spoken of highly in the world. Whatever acts destroy Darkness and Ignorance form yoga of the in respect of its real character.

sa: उदतिष्ठत् तपस्तप्त्वा दुश्चरं च महाह्रदात्। ततो देवातिदेवस्तं ब्रह्मा वै समसर्पत॥ तपोवृद्धिमपृच्छच्च कुशलं चैवमव्ययः। तपः सुचीर्णमिति च प्रोवाच वृषभध्वजः॥
en: His Yoga penances of the austerest type having been over, he rose from the great lake. Then that prime god of the gods, viz., the eternal Brahman, approached him, and enquired after the progress of his penances and well-being. The god having the bull for his emblem answered, saying,—My penances have been well practised.

sa: प्रकृत्या सर्गधर्मिण्या तथा त्रिगुणधर्मया। विपरीतमतो विद्यात् क्षेत्रज्ञस्य स्वलक्षणम्॥
en: Prakriti is endued with the three qualities. It is also engaged in creation. The true attributes of Kshetrajna (Purusha or the Soul) are different.

sa: तत्रैवावस्थितं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। निवृत्तिलक्षणं धर्ममव्यक्तं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्॥
en: Upon that depends the entire universe with its mobile and immobile creatures. The religion of disinclination again leads to the unmanifest and eternal Brahma.

sa: मयि वै त्यज्यतां क्रोधः किं मे क्रुद्धः करिष्यसि। न ते बिभेमि पवन यद्यपि त्वं स्वयं प्रभुः॥
en: Do you vomit all your anger upon me. By becoming angry, what will you do to me? Even if your power had been all your own, I would not still have been afraid of you. I am superior to you in power. I am not afraid of you.
